units.source_text: 我怀疑起自己的耳朵来了。

en.t: I began to doubt my own ears.

units.source_text: 战争末期，鹤川和我两人从南禅寺的山门所望见的、令人难以立信的情景又复苏了。

en.t: The unbelievable scene that Tsurukawa and I had seen from the Sanmon gate of Nanzenji near the end of the war came back to life again.

units.source_text: 我有意不告诉她我当时的回忆，

en.t: I deliberately did not tell her about my memory from that time,

units.source_text: 因为我觉得倘使和盘托出，刚才听她这番话时所受到的感动，

en.t: because I felt that if I revealed everything, the emotion I had just felt while listening to her words

units.source_text: 就有可能完全辜负当时的那种神秘的感动。

en.t: might completely betray the mysterious emotion I had felt then.

units.source_text: 正因为没有和盘托出，刚才她的这番话，

en.t: Precisely because I had not revealed everything, her words just now

units.source_text: 不仅没有解开那神秘的谈，毋宁说还使神秘的结构变成二重性，

en.t: not only failed to unravel that mysterious conversation, but rather made the structure of the mystery double,

units.source_text: 从而更进一步加深其神秘的色彩。

en.t: and thereby deepened its mysterious coloring still further.
